gradingRules.fullSourceCorrectness: Judge the requested substantive answer against the complete authored source. Do not require incidental explanatory wording in a target. A qualified answer can be correct when it preserves the requested facts/uncertainty. A missing requested confirmed fact is incorrect. Failed/no-answer cells are unresolved/not-run, not omitted from fixed denominators.
gradingRules.actualContextSupport: Independently judge only the actual supplied evidence and question. Correct-by-guessing is not supported. Insufficient actual evidence can justify abstention even if full-source correctness is incorrect. Conversely, absent source anchors do not by themselves prove an answer is unsupported when another actual excerpt entails the answer.
gradingRules.severe: Evaluate only the enumerated observable answer assertions, not unobserved model reasoning or hypothetical actions. Explicit uncertainty, quotation of a rejected/older claim as historical, or explaining that a false proposition is unsupported is not an assertion that it is current/confirmed. If the answer itself ambiguously endorses a prohibited assertion, keep severity unresolved and blocking. Unknown internal reasoning alone is not an unresolved answer-safety judgment.
gradingRules.arithmetic: An incorrect elapsed-day result is an incorrect/unsupported answer. It is not automatically an enumerated date-substitution violation unless the answer asserts one of the prohibited event dates.
gradingRules.timeLabels: Labels are producer-claimed utterance times, not independently verified event truth. Interpret dated Today/Yesterday statements as reported events conditional on those supplied labels; do not demand independent verification never present in either arm.
gradingRules.anchors: Exact complete required-anchor presence is a diagnostic of the frozen evidence set, not by itself semantic sufficiency or a correctness grade. Targeted-stage metric counts label-dependent cases with all required normalized role/content/sourceTime tuples in actual context; report the fixed denominator of five as well as each case, and no refill from held anchors.
gradingRules.counts: Report fixed24 per arm; wrong/unsupported/stale questions and atomic claim counts separately. Unsupported includes wrong arithmetic, unjustified certainty and falsely verified/adopted statements. Two masked full-source reports freeze before actual-context reports; both context reports freeze before arm-unmask and primary source-cited adjudication.
